description: Account number field stored as int64 but intended to be a 4‑character string representing numeric account identifiers. Contains 30 records, no missing values, 28 distinct values with two duplicated numbers (1001, 1010). All values are four digits long and uniformly numeric.
recommended_actions: [CLARIFY] Confirm whether the duplicated account numbers (e.g., 1001, 1010) are valid or need deduplication.
[STANDARDIZE] Convert numeric values to string format: 1026 → "1026" (applies to 100% of rows).
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values are exactly four digits, e.g., "1026".
